title.narrative: UNICEF has made significant strides in enhancing education access, reaching 587,528 children (308,034 boys and 279,494 girls) through various learning initiatives. Among them, 33,331 Out-of-School Children (OOSC) benefited from the non-formal education program, with 16,286 successfully mainstreamed into formal education.
